actual.rule: Trim every source string; blank strings normalize to null. Preserve unmodified values under raw.
ticket_type upper case; state casefold canonical map; do not infer unknown state or type from ticket number.

Group by normalized number, missing number treated as separate row. Choose greatest parseable updated_at <= cutoff; invalid/missing/future timestamp ranks below any valid timestamp. Ties select lowest source row. If all candidates lack valid timestamp select lowest source row and retain anomalies. Do not merge cells across versions.
actual.warning: Version selection is a provisional assumption, not confirmed user business rule. Both duplicate IDs are outside backlog here, so selection does not change these backlog KPI totals.

actual.rule: Cutoff 2026-10-01 18:00:00 is naive in same clock reference as Excel. No timezone conversion or browser local-time dependence. Use deterministic calendar arithmetic. Future dates remain traceable, but exclude them only from date-dependent evaluations: future opened_at excludes age and stale; future updated_at excludes stale only; future sla_due has no KPI effect.
